## Core Profile / Perfil Principal

Paco Fernández bridges the gap between visual aesthetics, online marketing, and modern performant code. He specializes in agile development methodologies (Vibe Coding) using Next.js, TypeScript, and WordPress as a Headless CMS (WPGraphQL / REST API).

- **Location / Ubicación:** Málaga, Spain / Remoto (Internacional)
- **Primary Domain / Dominio:** [disenadorenmalaga.es](https://www.disenadorenmalaga.es)
- **Contact / Contacto:** info@disenadorenmalaga.es
- **Roles:** Fullstack Product Developer, Digital Designer, Headless WordPress Architect, Online Marketing & SEO Specialist.
- **Key Technical Stack:** Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, TailwindCSS, Headless WordPress (WPGraphQL / REST API), Node.js, PostCSS.
- **AI & Vibe Coding:** Google AI Professional Certified, AI for App Building, Agentic workflows, Gemini, OpenAI, Qwen.
- **Marketing & Analytics:** Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics 4 (Consent Mode v2), SemRush, Looker Studio, SEO técnico.
- **Profiles / Enlaces:** [GitHub](https://github.com/Nobel74) | [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/franciscofernandezrodriguez/)

## Site Architecture & Paths

- `/es` & `/en` - Main interactive single-page application (SPA) featuring:
  - **Hero Section:** Dynamically colored particle background using brand palette interpolating smoothly.
  - **Portfolio Section:** Curated collection of web and graphic design projects, loaded dynamically from Headless WordPress.
  - **Experience Section:** Detailed career history across marketing direction, web engineering, and digital design.
  - **Education Section:** Formal IT degree (F.P. II Informática de Gestión) and continuous certifications (Google AI Professional, Frontend Master).
  - **Skills Section:** Technical proficiencies grouped by development, AI, online marketing, and graphic design.
  - **Soft Skills Section:** Communication, problem-solving, analytical mindset, and team collaboration.
  - **Languages Section:** Native Spanish, Professional English (C1).
  - **Contact Section:** Structured contact form, direct email channels, and digital vCard (.vcf) download.
- `/es/politica-privacidad` & `/en/privacy-policy` - Privacy policy pages styled in corporate colors, dynamically fetched with explicit noindex, follow directives.

## Featured Projects / Proyectos Destacados

- [ME-SIM.COM](https://www.disenadorenmalaga.es/es#proyectos): eSIM marketplace for travelers and digital nomads. Dynamic API parsing from supplier to frontend (WordPress, WooCommerce, JetEngine, Polylang).
- [Sergio Molina Masajista](https://www.disenadorenmalaga.es/es#proyectos): Health and wellness web platform focused on UX, local SEO, and client acquisition (WordPress, Elementor, Polylang).
- [MalagaCert](https://www.disenadorenmalaga.es/es#proyectos): High-conversion educational portal featuring dynamic exam schedules and lead capture (WooCommerce, JetEngine, Elementor).
- [David Sancho](https://www.disenadorenmalaga.es/es#proyectos): Digital art gallery and archive for the painter David Sancho (WordPress, Elementor).
- [Pistamancha](https://www.disenadorenmalaga.es/es#proyectos): Corporate international web platform developed at AcciónMK (WordPress, Elementor).
- [Federación Andaluza de Marketing](https://www.disenadorenmalaga.es/es#proyectos): Institutional portal unifying marketing clubs in Andalusia (WordPress, Divi).

## Interactive Elements & UX Details

- **Interactive Cursor:** Magnetic custom cursor with an outer ring tracker utilizing linear interpolation (`lerp`) and color-inversion over primary brand elements.
- **Micro-animations:** Card elevation on hover (`6px` vertical offset) with an HSL primary color glow (`10%` opacity).
- **Responsive Navigation:** Intelligent mobile header that conceals on scroll-down and reveals on scroll-up to maximize reading space.

- **Agentic Navigation Audit:** Scored a perfect **3/3 in Agentic Navigation** in technical audits, ensuring friction-free parsing for autonomous web agents.
